create_merge_config_linear: create a linear merge configuration for two models with specified weights using MergeConfig
create_merge_config_ties: create a TIES merge configuration for two models with density parameters using MergeConfig
create_merge_config_slerp: create a SLERP merge configuration for spherical linear interpolation of two models
merge_models: merge two models using mergekit with a MergeConfiguration and output path
upload_model_to_hf: upload a merged model folder to a Hugging Face Hub repository
